questions.q: A hockey pass in a match is best described as which type of skill?
questions.why: Players and defenders move, so the environment is unpredictable: open.

questions.q: Which type of feedback is information about the outcome of a performance?
questions.why: Knowledge of results = the outcome (score, time).

questions.q: According to the inverted-U theory, what happens when arousal is too high?
questions.why: After the optimum point, overarousal reduces performance.

questions.q: Describe the associative stage of learning.
questions.model: In the associative stage the performer makes fewer mistakes and movements become smoother. They can use feedback to refine the skill and are practising to improve consistency.
